paths.message: Effects are banned outside the effect hooks in src/hooks (useMountEffect, useEventListener, useInterval, useTimeout, useDirectoryChanges, useLatestLoad). Derive state during render, do it in the event handler, use a ref callback, or use one of those hooks.
